title: KhervePDF: A PDF viewer and annotation editor with built-in Git version history

creators.name: Kerhervé, Gwilherm
creators.affiliation: Department of Materials, Imperial College London

description: KhervePDF is an open-source tabbed PDF viewer and annotation editor. It provides annotation tools (pen, highlight, text, shapes, sticky notes, signatures, redaction), page operations (insert, delete, rotate, reorder, merge, split), AcroForm form filling, full-text search, and per-document Git version history with auto-commit and remote push. Built with Python, PySide6, PyMuPDF, pikepdf and pygit2.
